comment_regular: Close player dialogue and consume any globally parked clicked-Goodbye INFO with RunResult then AddTopicList. This path does not test RunForRumors. Therefore a Goodbye INFOGENERAL lacking RunForRumors can complete without closing, leave its result pending across later ordinary TOPIC choices, and commit only on a later close unless another Goodbye overwrites it.
